subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI add positional and cyclic session/agent switching shortcuts, and what visible session ordering and focus guard contract should they use?
rationale: The code has a clear implementation seam, but the requested behavior creates new global dashboard shortcut semantics and an active-session ordering contract that source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve Narrow Session Shortcuts
options.body: Add Ctrl/Cmd+1-9 and a cycle shortcut against the existing visible sidebar/session list, with editable-target guards and focused tests.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Defer shortcut semantics to the broader sessions overview work so ordering, pinned sessions, and peek/reply behavior are designed together.

options.title: Keep Mouse And Picker Only
options.body: Decline global session-switching shortcuts for now to avoid browser and editor conflicts while keeping the existing picker and sidebar model.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Session Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Add Ctrl/Cmd+1-9 and a cycle shortcut against the existing visible sidebar/session list, with editable-target guards and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the adjacent maintainer-scoped guarded shortcut direction, making them the best available owner for the shortcut-contract choice.
